experiment: exp110: FTW's 2nd-edition field map read as the package reads any probability map, at the FTW v1 test chips of Belgium, Croatia, Slovenia and Sweden

config.draw_seed: seed 110 + r for draw r (sample_for_estimation, sample_disagreement)

reading.map: p = field + boundary per mask pixel, read as a two-class probability map
reading.truth: majority of the window's 2-class mask pixels; an even split is left out
reading.mosaic: each country's chips side by side in sorted aoi_id order, one row
reading.pooled: the four countries' populations concatenated; each window keeps its country's control values (variance scaled by the country's band SDs, rarity within the country)

config.certify_route: certify_zone's steps with the order and the guard computed once per population; certify_zone itself on the first 20 draws per population at alpha 0.05

chip_cluster_reported.design: tiles of one chip (--tile 32), 16 windows per chip

P1.bar: AUROC >= 0.7, capture at 10% >= 0.25 and AUROC >= best control + 0.05, in >= 3 of 4 countries; floor 200 window errors

P2.bar: exact coverage >= 0.95 at B = 100 and 300 in all 10 cells, Monte Carlo within 3 se

P3a.bar: violation share <= 0.115 in each of 5 populations at alpha 0.05

P3b.bar: median certified share >= 0.25 at alpha 0.05 and 300 labels in >= 2 of 4 countries

P4a.bar: P(names the worse-agreeing map) <= 0.025 at n = 100 and 300, every country and pooled

P4b.bar: P(names the better-agreeing map) >= 0.8 at n = 100 in >= 3 of 4 countries

notes: The page's arm-4 reading says PRUE B3 never trained on these four countries. The B3 run's report (14 October 2026, after freezing) found that the v3.1 release notes and prue_efnet3.yaml point the other way: B3 most likely trained on these countries' train chips, as the 2e map's model did. The checkpoint stores no training list. P4's arithmetic does not depend on it; its reading does, and the owner has not settled it.

Not recorded: the page asks an audit that did not write this script to recompute theta, the error counts, AUROC, capture, K_A, K_B and one exact coverage cell with plain numpy before anything is recorded.
